Use Tier 2 architectural deepening, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation: add one jointly trained local sequence convolution inside MaskedSASRec. The 1,024-negative objective and relative attention bias both underperformed the 0.580 reference, so retain the reference architecture and 256-negative loss as the starting point. The hypothesis is that explicitly encoding adjacent purchase patterns will complement global attention; the observed plateau does not establish this as its cause.

Insert a residual local-context adapter immediately before the existing Transformer encoder, after input normalization and dropout. Mask padding representations to zero, apply a left-padded depthwise convolution with kernel size three, then GELU and a learned pointwise projection back to the hidden dimension. Add its output through a learned scalar gate initialized to zero, and mask padding again before attention. This gives the encoder access to ordered local item combinations while preserving the original network function at initialization; all candidate scores still come from the existing tied embedding head and jointly trained item bias.

Keep history sampling, auxiliary masking, loss weighting, optimizer, training seed 42, preprocessing seed 0, validation candidates, early stopping, and category time limits unchanged to isolate this architectural addition. Update checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer so validation and exported prediction reconstruct the adapter identically and strictly load exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category. Compare pinned host macro validation HR@10 and all four category scores against the 0.580 reference, report actual GPU cost, and print the selected checkpoints’ macro validation score. Preserve DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], supplied splits, four-category routing, trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution; use no external data, hidden test files, checkpoint reuse, independent scorers, or ensembles.
